explanation: Shrunk scenario has two massive bodies (1 ~17.7, 2 ~17.9) on colliding trajectories. By step 24 they are 1.13 apart, step 25 0.72, step 26 0.336 (close_pairs). Despite softening 0.3, leapfrog with dt ~0.026 and only 6 substeps cannot resolve the rapidly varying acceleration during the close approach, causing large energy jump: energy goes from ~86-102 to -47 (change 126.9 > allowed 108.3). Halving dt restores conservation, confirming timestep-resolution cause.
vision_note: Steps 23 to 26 show two large central bodies on converging trajectories that get progressively closer and are essentially overlapping by step 26. No wall collision or external intervention is visible; the anomaly is a rapid close approach/collision of the two massive bodies.
